# Claude Code video skills: find the right one, or publish your own

**Turn a video request in any language into the best-matching agent skill, its install command and the options to offer, with no key.**

**Typical cost** with `varg-ai`: ~$2–5 per typical short video. Models are billed at provider price, and the agent shows an estimate before you pay. **Free, no key:** `how-to-make-ai-video`, `video-skills`.

<p><a href="../../how-to-make-ai-video/README.md"><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_45aff7612d54.webp" alt="On varg how to, the search box gets the request &quot;ugc ad with an ai actor holding my product&quot; and returns a UGC collection, skills and prompt cards ranked for it." width="480"></a></p>

**Short answer:** start with [`how-to-make-ai-video`](../../how-to-make-ai-video/README.md): one keyless search over varg how to: best skill, install command, the 2-4 options to show, the steps, production order for a whole film. The other 3 skills below add the steps around it. Ask your agent for the result in your own words; it asks the few choices that matter before anything is paid for and hands back the files.

```bash
# Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other agents
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill how-to-make-ai-video --skill video-skills --skill varg-ai --skill varg-publish-skill
```

Then ask your agent in plain words, for example: *"Which skill should I use to make a lyric video for my song? Show me the options with examples before generating."*

## Requests to paste into your agent

- "Which skill should I use to make a lyric video for my song? Show me the options with examples before generating."
- "Find a skill for turning a spreadsheet into an animated chart video."
- "Publish my skill in ./my-skill/ to varg how to."
- "What's the status of the skills I submitted?"

## What you need

- The generation steps call the [varg API](https://varg.ai) (Seedance, Kling, Veo, GPT Image, ElevenLabs and more on one key). Sign in to the varg MCP with OAuth or set `VARG_API_KEY`. Models are billed at provider price, 1 credit = $0.01, and the agent shows an estimate before anything expensive.
- `varg-ai`: ~$2–5 per typical short video.
- `varg-publish-skill`: free.
- Any agent that reads Agent Skills: Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and others ([install options](../../README.md#install)).

## FAQ

### Which skill should I use for my video?

Ask in your own words: how-to-make-ai-video searches varg how to (2,000+ checked video skills and tutorials) and returns the best skill with its install command, the 2-4 choices to put to you with example videos, and the steps. One call takes about 0.1-0.5 s, needs no key and works in any language.

### Do I need an API key to search?

No. The search is public, also as an MCP server at https://api.varg.ai/v2/skills/mcp. Generation needs a varg account (the varg-ai skill or the varg MCP with OAuth).

### How do I install these skills?

npx skills add vargHQ/skills --yes, or in Claude Code: claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills, then claude plugin install varg@varg.

### Do they work in Codex, Cursor or Gemini CLI?

They follow the Agent Skills standard; the README names Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, OpenCode and ClawHub, and the repo ships a Gemini CLI extension file.

### How do I publish my own video skill?

varg-publish-skill reads your skill folder or repo, checks it against the varg media skill standard, fills the one card format (name, summary, triggers, category, install command, a real example), shows it to you and sends it for review with publish_skill. The team usually reviews within a day.
